questions.question: Which service is explicitly not going to be migrated at all?
Why won't auth-service be migrated?
questions.gold_answer: It carries a lot of bespoke compliance logic that would be expensive and risky to port, and the migration risk was judged not worth the benefit.

questions.question: Is auth-service's non-migration a permanent decision or just a scheduling delay?
questions.gold_answer: Permanent for now — explicitly stated as not a scheduling delay.

questions.question: Which service was migrated and then rolled back?
Why was search-service's migration rolled back?
questions.gold_answer: Data-consistency bugs — search results lagged behind the source-of-truth database.

questions.question: Which service is running on both the old and new infrastructure at the same time?
questions.gold_answer: reporting-service, and it's the only one on the list in that state.

questions.question: When is notifications-service scheduled to migrate?
